title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: users can upload local and OneDrive files to custom engine agents
summary: Hold: the general statements about metered billing and agents being off by default omit Microsoft's distinctions between Basic and Premium licences. The roadmap details and the documented blocking and user-access controls check out, but the cited admin guide no longer supports the claimed blanket compliance assurance.

claims.claim: For custom engine agents in general, agents accessing shared tenant data are billed on metered consumption.
claims.quote: If you have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, using agents in Copilot Chat, Microsoft Teams, or SharePoint for classic answers, generative answers, or Microsoft Graph tenant grounding isn't charged when the agent runs with your authenticated identity.
claims.fix: Replace the billing statement with 'For Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 (Basic) licences, agents accessing shared tenant data are billed on metered consumption. For Microsoft 365 Copilot licence holders, classic answers, generative answers and Microsoft Graph tenant grounding are not charged when the agent runs with their authenticated identity in Copilot Chat, Teams or SharePoint.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/manage-agents-copilot-chat and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/billing-licensing. In the cost rationale, qualify metered shared-data access with 'for Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 (Basic) licences' and attribute it to the purchase guide, not the redirected Agents admin guide.

claims.claim: Agents using metered consumption are off by default for users in Microsoft Copilot Chat generally.
claims.quote: Pay-as-you-go agents are turned off by default for Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) users. ... No action is needed to enable agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium).
claims.fix: Replace the default statement with 'Pay-as-you-go agents are off by default for Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) users; no action is needed to enable agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium).' Attribute it to and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/manage-agents-copilot-chat, not the redirected Agents admin guide.
